reason: I have one apartment next to my house, the agency already talks to my guests, and my laminated sheet covers the Wi-Fi and the rules. My guests knock on my door and I like that, I don't need a machine answering for me.
objection: My guests like talking to me personally, not to a robot, and I already pay the agency. Another €35 a month and €150 to start is a lot out of my pension for something I do myself over a coffee.
would_change_my_mind: If my agency included it at no extra cost, or my grandson set it up and showed me that guests still came to me for the personal things.
